Q: C_CPP.intellisense disabled. How to enable again A:

I had the same issue and for me it did help to do as nelow:

  • CTRL + , to go to settings

  • Search for intelliSenseEngine

  • Set the value to "default" (not Default or something else)

Hope this will help you!

Q: Multi-Sensor Data Fusion for Pile Strain Analysis A:

Extensometers:
As you mentioned blue is System A Set 1, orange ist System A Set 2. System A measures the deformation over its built-in length. That means you get constant deformation values over their section-lengths. Of each Set ther is two. I already calculated their mean value as their depths are the same.
Vibrating Wire Strain Gauges:
System B measures the deformation very locally (only 30 cm), so I showed them as points (yellow).

I dont know how to obtain the grey curve. That is what I want to know, or at least how can I reproduce similar results?
